notes: Use raised card #ffffff; shared chrome surface is #fafbfc, recessed wells #ebeef3. Body copy uses #2a2f38. Shadow is an animated authored expression with initial breath=.55; reduced motion uses .6. Main accent is sky #0ea5e9; author also labels #7dd3fc primary softer accent and uses #0284c7 for active. Accent is sparse; do not fill all surfaces. Body is clamp(.98rem,1.1vw,1.1rem), lower bound recorded. Mobile title overrides to 2.8–4.2rem or 2.4–3.4rem. Shadow above normalizes an authored syntax error: --si-shadow-rgb is 30 41 59 but rgba(var(--si-shadow-rgb), 0.12) mixes space and comma syntaxes, so actual computed shadow may be invalid/none; validate in browser. Proper runtime spelling is rgb(var(--si-shadow-rgb) / 0.12).
